test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A sum of ₹3680 is invested at 12.5%p.a. simple interest for 6 years. What will be the total amount payable on maturity?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 3 , 680

Rate of interest = 12.5% = 1/8

Time = 6 years

**Formula used:**

Simple interest = (Principal × time × rate)/100

**Calculation:**

Simple interest = (3680 × 12.5 × 6)/100

 

⇒ S.I = 3680 × (1/8) × 6

⇒ S.I = 2760

∴ The amount after maturity

⇒ (AMOUNT + S.I)

⇒ Rs. (3,680 + 2,760)

⇒ Rs. 6440

**∴ Hence , the amount after maturity = Rs. 6440.**
